# AI Coding Agent Instructions for PicoDCC

**The project rules live in [`CLAUDE.md`](../CLAUDE.md) at the repository root. Read that file.**

It is the single source of truth for build modes, the non-negotiable safety and memory
rules, architecture, transport facts, conventions and workflow. This file used to carry a
second copy of all of it; the two drifted, so the copy was retired rather than maintained.

Deeper reference material is indexed in [`docs/README.md`](../docs/README.md), with
`docs/architecture.md` as the main design document.

If you are adding or changing a project rule, change it in `CLAUDE.md`. Do not reintroduce
rules here.
